basis: Measured from the installed pinned CountryTaxBenefitSystem by the compute lane; these are processed parameters, not raw YAML.
sampling_rule: For each year2015..2040, sample each government Parameter at April30 and update the whole nominal year to that value.
reproducer: from policyengine_uk import CountryTaxBenefitSystem; s=CountryTaxBenefitSystem(); p=s.parameters.gov.hmrc.national_insurance.class_1.rates.employee.main; print({d:p(d) for d in ('2024-01-01','2024-04-06','2024-04-30','2024-12-31')}); print([(v.instant_str,v.value) for v in p.values_list if v.instant_str.startswith('2024')])
